payload.name: Tiny Perceptron trained AV and finite-sound research artifacts
payload.body:
# Tiny Perceptron: trained audiovisual and finite-sound research artifacts

These are original, fixed training artifacts from CPU run 40988311100. Training source: f9310888eaa95e79156ffddea122a8c9b1d6beb5. The original eleven ZIP assets and all checksums are preserved. The public downloader is supplied by the independently reviewed software on main; use the fixed descriptor at docs/omni-products/v1/public-release.json. The revised textbook is undergoing its own readability, correctness and coherence reviews.

The selected audiovisual model is av-time-rope-s29, chosen on development data before final evaluation. On the fixed final set it answered both time-shifted items correctly in 200/200 families. A separate sound-content swap control passed 148/200 families. This is a finite synthetic shape-and-sound task; the main score does not establish general video understanding.

The codec and Talker are trained from scratch for finite 220/440/880 Hz sound programs, not human speech. Gold-program and actual audiovisual-conditioned chains each passed 200/200 fixed families. All autoregressive codes are produced before chunk decoding. Reported internal chunk timings exclude startup, model loading, WAV writing and playback.

C (c-augmented) is an experimental research candidate and does not replace the old default. Final Choice was 39/60, information sufficiency 55/60, rubric 35/60. The frozen policy accepted 53 cases and made 19 errors (35.85% accepted risk), failing its 5% target. Temperature and threshold are fixed from separate calibration/policy data; no final retuning was performed. c-compact is included only as the preregistered data-control model.

The original Looped solver and legacy assistant remain unchanged. The limited 100-family automatic-routing integration achieved 55/100 actual end-to-end success. These results do not establish a generally reliable assistant.

Training archives contain both safetensors inference weights and complete optimizer/RNG state. The default public downloader verifies all ZIP members and installs inference files without deserializing .pt continuation state. Selected AV/C/codec/Talker safetensors total 2,192,940 bytes; ZIP downloads are larger because they retain training evidence and state.

Final measurements: https://github.com/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm/actions/runs/41004229262 . Core training: https://github.com/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm/actions/runs/40988311100 . The complete training recipes, selections, final-opening identity, result limitations and independent execution verification are in the repository. Qwen and Kev weights or teacher outputs were not used to train these models.

payload.name: Tiny Perceptron fixed final measurements
payload.body:
# Tiny Perceptron: original fixed final measurements

Original results of CPU final run 41004229262, source ee799d24fd1ea26108af709ec41e49db63d58e31. Original asset final-results.zip (ID 690952957, 1,827,422 bytes), SHA-256: 50b11a952e9ceb57eafa00891b710f44157a17adb742b69abad61655365c8de3. No training, weight reselection or final retuning was performed during evaluation.

Selected AV av-time-rope-s29 passed 200/200 fixed main families; separate sound-content swap 148/200. Finite-sound gold and actual-AV chains each passed 200/200, with different held-out conditions documented in the archive. C Choice 39/60, information 55/60, rubric 35/60; its fixed policy accepted 53 with 19 errors, failing the 5% risk target. Automatic-routing integration actual end-to-end 55/100. The old C remains default; the new C is a labelled research candidate. These synthetic tasks do not establish general video, speech or assistant capability.

The archive contains the four original measurement files, frozen selections and 600 WAV files with a complete per-file manifest. Independent execution verification confirms discrete counts and fixed capability decisions without replaying neural inference. Cross-host pure-math replay differs in 43 statistics by at most 2.220446049250313e-16; the original exact-dictionary assertion rejects such last-bit differences. The original measurements and thresholds are preserved.

Training artifacts: https://github.com/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm/releases/tag/omni-core-candidate-cpu-core-40988311100-1 . Original run: https://github.com/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm/actions/runs/41004229262 . The revised textbook has a separate three-review publication process.

payload.body:
# Kev-4B: fixed limited research results

Original completed run 41011677439, source 010a639f6db4889ecbac5801dcab7a7a4409e8f0. Both original input.zip and result.zip retain their asset IDs and exact checksums. result.zip SHA-256: 1261b695cd6f1e1b429880cb0554fe3ff7f6c8231d3e70e6429bc8505a7bb566. No Kev, Qwen or adapter weights are distributed here.

Pinned jaredpalmer/kev code: 2074cc44256200bb37540103fa4572901faa10f3; adapter: 6cfce5c2fa4b4bd64026336ab649c5ca78857d52; Qwen3.5-4B-Base: 1001bb4d826a52d1f399e183466143f4da7b741b. Direct FP32 loading, raw head T=1, TF32 disabled, option_isolation=false. The input archive includes the required small Apache-2.0 code snapshot and LICENSE; output rows are project-authored measurements.

English calibration 80 families selected T=1.8340080864093424; separate policy 60 families selected tau=0.8. Final 60 families were measured in two correlated STATE language views; questions and candidate descriptions remain English. English Choice 42/60, information 59/60, rubric 35/60; fixed policy 18 accepted and 1 error, 30% coverage and 5.56% accepted risk, above 5%. Chinese-state Choice 32/60, information 49/60, rubric 33/60; 1 accepted and 0 errors is too little evidence for a robust low-risk claim. These are 60 shared families, not 120 independent observations, and no fair causal architecture comparison is established. Pretraining exposure is not excluded.

Eight development families checked cached/full recomputation and Q1-Q2-Q1 isolation with unchanged prefix fingerprints. Candidate permutation was not measured for mature Kev. Independent original-artifact verification replayed statistics only, with zero neural inference. Termination is supported by contemporaneous provider records; a new local live Modal RPC inspection was unavailable. The revised textbook has a separate three-review process.

Original run: https://github.com/birdhackor/tiny-perceptron-vlm/actions/runs/41011677439 .
